defects.rationale: os.system is invoked with an f-string interpolating the untrusted `filename` argument directly into a shell command, allowing shell metacharacters (e.g. '; rm -rf /') to execute arbitrary commands. Based on the objective-provided source only; the read_code artifact s1 failed, so line numbering is taken from the inline snippet.

The return value of os.system (the exit status) is returned to the caller without any check, so a nonzero/failed conversion is indistinguishable from success at the call site. Evidence limited to the inline snippet; s1 is blocked.
